newsitem.title: ITALY: Lira ERM talks will take a "bit of time" - Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Lira ERM talks will take a "bit of time" - Prodi.

text.p: Italy is ready to initiate technical talks on putting the lira back into the European exchange rate mechanism (ERM), but this will take a bit of time, Prime Minister Romano Prodi said in a radio interview.
"In these days we have said we are ready to begin technical negotiations. This will need a bit of time and then we will return to the ERM," Prodi said.
The government has always said that the 1997 budget needed to pass the lower house of parliament before talks could begin on the lira's return to the ERM.
The budget passed the lower house hurdle on Saturday.

A Reuter poll of 10 economists in Italy and London published earlier on Wednesday showed that the lira was widely expected to return to the ERM before the end of this month with many in the market forecasting its central parity against the mark would be 1,000 lire. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
